messages:
maria-oncall: :rotating_light: Observing an uptick in GPU pod scheduling failures in us-east4 starting ~1719998888. Mount/attach failures to NVMe model-store, some nodes auto-evacuating. Est ~22% active sessions impacted. Opening thread to coordinate failover and customer comms.

jake-sre: Confirmed. dmesg shows repeated 'nvme detach/attach timeout' and multi-host PCIe fabric retries. Several kubelets are marking nodes NotReady while kube-scheduler reschedules.

sana-runtime: Tagging likely-affected endpoints: gpt-medium-v2, embed-2, multimodal-resize. Traffic policy still sending ~65% to us-east4 based on affinity.

maria-oncall: Proposed immediate plan: shift 50% traffic -> us-west2 over next 12m, then 90% if metrics look good. Enable async KV replication for canary endpoints. @sana-runtime pls update routing weights and warm caches.

sana-runtime: Applying staged reroute now.

deploy-bot: Route-weight update initiated by sana-runtime.

sana-runtime: Runbook snippet:
```
/runbook evict-failure-shift --from=us-east4 --to=us-west2 --stages=50,90 --kv-replicate=async --notify=support
```

tom-support: Which customers are seeing the biggest hit? Need a prioritized triage list for account teams.

jake-sre: Metrics show highest error volumes from: nova-ai, ledgerco, jotform. I'll DM their AMs and paste a short status blurb for support.

catherine-pm: Draft status copy (please review):
"We are currently experiencing degraded inference capacity in our us-east4 GPU pool due to storage attach/PCIe errors. We are shifting traffic to us-west2 and mobilizing engineering to restore full capacity. Some customers may see higher latency and occasional timeouts. ETA for initial mitigation: 1-3 hours. No customer data exposure detected."

ops-cost: Heads-up on costs: cross-region egress + burst instance provisioning will add roughly $3k-6k/day if active. Suggest enabling short-lived burst capacity in us-west2 only and monitor.

maria-oncall: Good call. We'll enable conservatively. @ops-cost open a temporary invoice exception.

statusbot: Incident created: INC-2026-us-east4-modelstore-attach. Bridge: https://zoom/incident/xyz

maria-oncall: Stage 1 shift to us-west2 (50%) started. Early telemetry: request error-rate down 40% for canaries, but p95 latency +140ms.

sana-runtime: Warming model caches and priming async KV replication. Rolling new model shards into us-west2 to reduce cold-starts.

nova-eng (DM): Thanks. We're seeing our SDK backpressure kicking in. Any way to prioritize our sessions?

maria-oncall: Reply to nova: we can add a priority tag for your tenant; will do if you confirm. Full shift ETA 45-90m depending on replica health.

jake-sre: Opened provider ticket #VEND-44112. Vendor reports an edge routing flap on their private interconnect; they are investigating. Initial vendor ETA 2-4 hours for root cause.

maria-oncall: Draft status posted to status page. Please review/support copy.

tom-support: Pasting customer DM template to top 25 affected accounts:
"Hi <Customer>, we detected elevated errors in our us-east4 region and are shifting traffic to us-west2. You may experience transient higher latency or timeouts for up to a few hours. We are prioritizing impacted customers — reply if you need a dedicated bridge"

catherine-pm: minor wording tweak approved. Publish when ready.

sana-runtime: Rolling to 90% now. Monitoring GPU VRAM pressure and NVMe attach retry counts.

jake-sre: Vendor applied an interim routing fix at ~1719999200 which reduced flapping but did not resolve NVMe timeouts. We're collecting kernel and firmware logs for vendor.

ops-cost: Enabling burst GPU nodes in us-west2 for the short window. Noted temporary cost approval.

maria-oncall: Update: traffic at 96% us-west2, overall errors returned to baseline for most tenants. A few clients still seeing retries; support has a priority queue open. Keeping incident open until vendor provides root cause and we validate post-fix stability. :white_check_mark:

sana-runtime: Follow-ups: evaluate changing regional affinity to prefer multi-region replicas for model store; consider pre-scheduled cross-region cache warmups for high-risk failovers to minimize egress.

jake-sre: I'll keep vendor ticket open and request full timeline + packet captures for postmortem. Also logging hardware serials for nodes that saw repeated NVMe resets.

tom-support: Closing immediate customer escalation queue — will re-open on request.

maria-oncall: Thanks team. Filing incident report and scheduling post-incident review for tomorrow. Ping this thread if anything regresses.
